about.description:
KLayout is an open-source layout viewer and editor for semiconductor
designs. This package provides the full application and the Python
bindings built from the KLayout sources with Qt6:

- klayout: GUI application and command-line tool (batch mode -b)
- buddy tools: strm2gds, strm2oas, strm2txt, strmclip, strmxor, strmrun, ...
- Python module: klayout.db, klayout.lay, klayout.tl, klayout.rdb,
  klayout.pex, klayout.lib, klayout.pya (with Qt bindings)

Use `klayout -b` for batch processing or `import klayout.db as db`
in Python scripts.
about.summary: KLayout layout viewer and editor with Python bindings

script: export QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen
klayout -v
python -c "import klayout.db as db; assert db.__version__ == '${{ version }}', db.__version__; print('klayout.db version OK', db.__version__)"

python -c "import klayout.db as db; ly = db.Layout(); ly.dbu = 0.001; top = ly.create_cell('TOP'); layer = ly.layer(1, 0); top.shapes(layer).insert(db.Box(0, 0, 1000, 2000)); ly.write('roundtrip.gds'); ly2 = db.Layout(); ly2.read('roundtrip.gds'); assert ly2.top_cell().name == 'TOP'; print('GDS roundtrip OK')"
strm2oas roundtrip.gds roundtrip.oas
python -c "import klayout.db as db; ly = db.Layout(); ly.read('roundtrip.oas'); assert ly.top_cell().name == 'TOP'; print('OASIS via strm2oas OK')"
echo "import pya; p = pya.Application.instance().inst_path(); print(p); assert p.endswith('lib/klayout'), p" > inst_path.py
klayout -b -r inst_path.py

name: klayout
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.30.12"

package:
  name: klayout
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/KLayout/klayout/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: fa747d9a4c216d0645587e05df365d5c22f73609ab98b34471372c711d8c2b75

build:
  number: 1
  skip:
    # linux-only for now: build script only handles the unix qmake build
    - win
    - osx
  script:
    file: build_klayout.sh

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - make
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
  host:
    - python
    - qt6-main
    - qt6-multimedia
    - libgl-devel
    - libopengl-devel
    - libpng
    - libcurl
    - expat
    - zlib
    - libgit2
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - klayout
        - klayout.db
        - klayout.lay
        - klayout.tl
        - klayout.rdb
        - klayout.pex
        - klayout.lib
        - klayout.pya
  - script:
      - export QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen
      - klayout -v
      - python -c "import klayout.db as db; assert db.__version__ == '${{ version }}', db.__version__; print('klayout.db version OK', db.__version__)"
      - python -c "import klayout.db as db; ly = db.Layout(); ly.dbu = 0.001; top = ly.create_cell('TOP'); layer = ly.layer(1, 0); top.shapes(layer).insert(db.Box(0, 0, 1000, 2000)); ly.write('roundtrip.gds'); ly2 = db.Layout(); ly2.read('roundtrip.gds'); assert ly2.top_cell().name == 'TOP'; print('GDS roundtrip OK')"
      - strm2oas roundtrip.gds roundtrip.oas
      - python -c "import klayout.db as db; ly = db.Layout(); ly.read('roundtrip.oas'); assert ly.top_cell().name == 'TOP'; print('OASIS via strm2oas OK')"
      - echo "import pya; p = pya.Application.instance().inst_path(); print(p); assert p.endswith('lib/klayout'), p" > inst_path.py
      - klayout -b -r inst_path.py
